targets.title: The nature of verbal impairment after closed head injury.
targets.evidence_quote: This study is a replication of an earlier study published in this journal (Sarno, M. T. The nature of verbal impairment after closed head injury. J. Nerv. Ment. Dis., 1968: 685-692, 1980).
targets.outcome_quote: This study confirms the observation that all CHI postcoma patients suffer important, disabling verbal changes, however mild or apparent, which persist up to 1 year post-trauma.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The author explicitly confirms the earlier observation, and the abstract also states multiple matching findings.

reasoning: A completed replication in 69 new postcoma patients. The abstract supplies the original citation and an explicit confirmation; no original DOI is printed. Open access indexes and publisher route did not yield full text.
skip_reason: Full text unavailable from publisher and open-access indexes.
